title: Three-dimensional rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero degrees and the translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, draw the first line from the origin at (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.1406). Continue with the third line from (0.75, 0.1406) to (0.0, 0.1406), and complete the loop by drawing the fourth line from (0.0, 0.1406) back to the origin. After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Next, transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with the translation vector set to zero. Finally, extrude the transformed sketch along the normal direction by 0.0469 units to create a three-dimensional rectangular prism. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the rectangular prism should be 0.75 units in length, 0.1406 units in width, and 0.0469 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.1406) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.1406) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular prism
r = r.extrude(0.0469)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
